e036fda7fca4182e8cdaa68ecd9dcce05c3ed031.sourceText: `time_increment` 写死为0，表示没有逐束时间差；`header.stamp` 沿用输入点云时间。地形输入含历史点，不能把这个结果当成所有射线确实在同一时刻由物理二维雷达采集，也不能用scan_time代替运动补偿或修复上游点时间单位。
e036fda7fca4182e8cdaa68ecd9dcce05c3ed031.translatedText: `time_increment`Hard\-coded to 0, indicating there is no per\-beam time difference;`header.stamp`Follows the input point cloud time\. Terrain input contains historical points; this result must not be treated as all rays actually being acquired at the same instant by a physical 2D radar, nor may scan_time be used in place of motion compensation or to fix the upstream point time unit\.
